_about: Batch S1 terms (home, learn/vllm-plugins, code/index, code/init-py). Owner: writer S1. Reuse core.json ids; do not redefine them.

load-general-plugins.short: The vLLM function that loads every plugin in the vllm.general_plugins group, then calls each one. It runs once per process.
load-general-plugins.long: Defined in vLLM ({{cite vllm:vllm/plugins/__init__.py:77-90}}); a guard stops a second run in the same process.

model-registry.short: vLLM's registry of model architectures. A plugin adds a model with register_model, using a lazy "module:Class" string.
model-registry.long: The singleton is defined in vLLM ({{cite vllm:vllm/model_executor/models/registry.py:1523-1531}}); register_afd calls it for each AFD model ({{cite afd_plugin/__init__.py:211-214}}).
